newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 7.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 7.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Goodman reported early on Friday a first half net profit before abnormals of A$55.5 million, up 4.9 percent and in line with analysts' expectations of A$55 million to A$59 million. Goodman also announced it would sell its European milling and baking business, Meneba NV, for slightly more than A$300 million to Dutch-based CVC Capital Partners BV. It also said it had agreed to buy the New Zealand milling and baking operations of Defiance Mills Ltd for NZ$48 million.

Village Roadshow Ltd said late on Thursday it expected stronger second half earnings fuelled by the expansion of its cinema operations. Village earlier reported a 27 percent rise in net profit to A$26.1 million for the 1996/97 first half.
A trading halt has been placed on Amalg's shares at the company's request.

Winemaker BRL Hardy Ltd said on Thursday strong sales had continued in Australia and overseas since the end of 1996, giving the company confidence of further success through the rest of 1997. BRL Hardy earlier reported a 33 percent rise in net profit to A$23.07 million in calendar 1996. Sales rose eight percent to A$309.02 million in the year, with 29 percent of total sales accounted for by international sales.
